headline: EFG International Reports Record Assets and 10% Profit Rise
summary: Zurich-based private bank EFG International maintained rapid growth in the first ten months of the year, with assets under management reaching a record high and adjusted profit rising about 10%.
why: EFG International is a prominent Swiss private banking group managing assets for high-net-worth individuals globally.
